Adds an optional operator-owned `[telemetry.activity_hook]` foreground command to hold a host awake while native clients or runtime work require execution. The hook remains independent of collectors and preserves local configuration across sink updates. Activity measurements run alongside the complete server loop; shutdown cancels hook and collector measurements before actor cleanup and releases the child process group. Uses Core 0.16.19 with accurate live compaction notices. Gateway wire is unchanged.
